rationale: Origin front geometry is 64x64 with y_offset 0, matching Emerald Rayquaza's front geometry class.
Stock Emerald applies gEnemyMonElevation only to opponent-side battlers.
Back sprite should therefore retain its own composition rather than adding a new player-side elevation system.
This is a project mapping candidate based on target-engine behavior, not an official Generation IV numeric value.

platinum_height_o_observation.interpretation: Platinum alternate-form sprite yOffset data for these entries is 0; do not reinterpret it directly as Gen III elevation.
